jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Job Description

Internship Duration : Full time 6-month period, from Q3 2027

At Codex Solutions, we’re on a mission to empower the Home Team with modern, resilient, and intelligent systems that protect lives and strengthen Singapore’s safety and security fabric.

As a Software Engineer Intern, you’ll be part of a hands-on engineering team building robust software systems and integrating practical AI capabilities into real-world applications. You’ll gain experience developing modern software solutions while learning how AI features are designed, built, and deployed in enterprise environments.

You’ll get to explore, prototype, and implement solutions that streamline work and bring real value to the organisation. If you enjoy writing code, breaking problems down into logical components, and turning ideas into working software, this internship is for you.

Why This Matters

AI is changing how organisations operate — automating routine tasks, enabling smarter decisions, and freeing people to focus on what truly matters.

This internship gives you the opportunity to apply software engineering principles to AI-enabled systems, designing and building tools that support corporate automation while learning how real-world software is developed, tested, and improved over time.

What To Expect

Design, develop, and prototype modern full-stack web applications and backend services using contemporary frameworks.
Build reusable platform foundations and common services, including shared libraries, UI templates, and modules that accelerate product development.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify high-impact business areas where AI can drive efficiency and innovation.
Develop and integrate intelligent features into software products, including LLM-driven text extraction, interactive assistants, and structured data generation.
Support the full lifecycle of end-to-end software and AI implementation from ideation and proof-of-concept to testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.
Stay curious about emerging AI and software development trends, sharing insights and experimental findings with the wider team.

Job Requirements

During the internship, you will get to learn and experience:

How to apply software engineering fundamentals (modular design, API design, debugging, and testing) when building enterprise-grade and AI-enabled systems.
Hands-on experience developing full-stack web applications and reusable platform services, and integrating modern AI models and APIs into functional software products.
Practical skills in integrating LLM APIs and leveraging AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate software development workflows.
An introduction to secure and reliable software development, including data protection, containerization best practices, and understanding system and AI limitations.

jobs.description:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.

With more than 54,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

About Atos Group

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 56,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion (at the go-forward perimeter), operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.

About The Role

The solution delivered must be stable, performant, scalable, documented, easy to use, secure, easy to maintain and to operate in order to offer a good user experience.

The developer defines designs, builds, deploys and maintains relevant & valuable information systems to support business stakes.

Responsibilities:
Utilizing Microsoft's .NET, Angular, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL infrastructure to create software solutions that meet clients' requirements.
Utilize established
development tools (.NET, Angular, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL), guidelines, and conventions
.NET developers create presentable, well-functioning software using Microsoft's .NET framework. as such, .NET developers should demonstrate advanced proficiency in at least one of the applicable coding languages, plus excellent graphic design skills
Works collaboratively with Project Manager to ensure timely delivery of project.
Coordinate with Business Analysts and business process owners to ensure that the developed solution meets technical requirements and client needs.
Prepare technical documents as per established project standards.
Check your code to detect and remedy errors and omissions.
Testing your outputs to ensure that they are in excellent working order.
Ensuring that outputs are visually appealing, user-friendly, and engaging.

Develop and implement minor or major changes to the region applications portfolio.

KEY EXPECTED ACHIEVEMENTS
Team performance

Demonstrates on a daily basis Agile & Lean values like cooperation, transparency, courage and humility to foster teamwork. Continuously reflect on how to become more effective, tunes and adjusts team norms and helps to update IT standards. Develop and maintain high connection with central data stewards in order to maintain a good value for the datasets that data engineer and the team is building and deploying.

Deliver Right:

A stable, performing, scalable, easy to use data driven solution will be delivered to business.

Solution Maintenance:

The Developer maintains and optimizes a working solution in «marche courante»/ day to day operations by providing support level 3

Preferred experience and qualifications

Relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Digital & Data Analytics or similar with focus on software development
At least 3 years of hands-on experience in PostgreSQL & MS SQL Database Administration/ Engineering

Database Design and Management

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About us

Founded in 2015 in Athens, Greece, Welcome redefines the way people travel by going above and beyond the commoditized transfer service and being the first company to deliver a complete, personalised, in-destination travel experience. From the moment a traveler arrives at a new destination, until their return journey home, Welcome accommodates all their travel needs, including transfers, sightseeing trips, and local information, in the easiest, friendliest, and most personalised way possible. Welcome's drivers are experts in the area and share their local know-how to make travellers feel at home wherever they are. The company has also introduced contactless rides, thorough cleaning protocols, and protective equipment to make every journey safe.
Being a travel tech startup, Welcome continues to grow and scale its operations and is quickly becoming a global category leader for in-destination travel services.
One of the highest-rated global transportation companies with a rating of 4.9/5 stars.
Expanded from 200 destinations last year to 350, achieving our ambitious 2024 growth target.
Over 4,000 travel partners including 2,500 hotels, numerous vacation rentals, and travel agents, adding 50+ new ones every month.
Over 2.5 million happy travellers every year.

⭐️ If you want to dive deeper into the awesomeness of Welcome's culture, click
on this link
 to check our TikTok account.⭐️

The Team

We are a group of vibrant, diverse people who love travelling and never settle on quality. Each one of us didn't join Welcome by chance and believes deeply in what Welcome is trying to achieve, so we work relentlessly to make that happen. We challenge common logic, focus on design, put simplicity and usability first, and create memorable experiences. We keep learning and exploring better ways to serve our community and grow personally and professionally in our respective fields. We stay humble along the way, with a "pay it forward" mentality, but with big and bold goals.
As a Senior Platform Engineer
at Welcome Pickups ,
you will keep the platform behind our product reliable, fast, scalable and secure, so travellers, drivers and partners can count on our services every day. Much of what we do runs in the background: matching rides to drivers, pricing, notifications, partner syncs and payouts. If the platform slows down or stops, rides don't get assigned and travellers end up waiting at arrivals. This is a hands-on role that works across all our product teams. You will make key architecture and infrastructure decisions, set the standards everyone builds to, and own the technical roadmap together with the Product Manager of the Core team. The role is about helping product teams move fast without breaking things, not slowing them down.
What you'll work with

A large Ruby on Rails application, with Sidekiq and RabbitMQ
A large, fast-growing PostgreSQL/PostGIS database, plus Elasticsearch and Redis
Azure as our main cloud, with AWS S3 and Google Cloud
Cloud66, Cloudflare, CircleCI and Docker
New Relic and Rollbar for monitoring, and Mixpanel for product analytics
30+ external services, including Checkout.com, Twilio, Braze and hotel booking systems

Responsibilities

Reliability & Uptime

Define and track reliability targets (SLAs/SLOs) for our core flows: bookings, ride matching and payments.
Set up and run the incident process and on-call, and reduce recovery times.
Improve monitoring and alerting across the platform (New Relic, Rollbar).

Performance, Scalability & Data

Lead architecture decisions for scaling our backend systems and services.
Find and fix performance bottlenecks across the application, background jobs and database.
Improve the performance of our large, fast-growing PostgreSQL database:
tune slow queries and indexes
plan data growth and archiving
manage replication, backups and restore drills
change large tables without downtime

Make sure the platform handles peak season and partner growth smoothly.

Infrastructure, Security & Compliance

Define and evolve our infrastructure strategy on Azure, and balance performance, reliability and cost.
Define and enforce security best practices: access control, secrets management, and the security of our build and release pipeline.
Prepare the platform for compliance: payment-data rules (PCI), GDPR, and over time SOC 2 / ISO 27001.

Developer Experience

Improve internal tooling, CI/CD and deployment workflows so engineers can ship faster and safer.

Technical Roadmap & Collaboration

Keep the backlog of technical work (upgrades, technical debt, performance, security) organised and ranked in Jira, and prioritise it together with the Product Manager.
Write technical docs, runbooks and development plans, and break them into Jira tickets with clear requirements.
Participate in team ceremonies (grooming, planning, kick-off meetings, retrospectives & demos).

Requirements

8+ years of software engineering experience, with strong backend and systems experience.
BS/MS degree in Computer Science or a related subject.
Proven experience operating and scaling production systems.

Technical Skills
Strong understanding of system design, distributed systems and performance trade-offs.
Strong PostgreSQL skills on large databases: query and index tuning, replication, large-table migrations, backups.
Experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred), Docker and infrastructure-as-code.
Experience with Redis, Elasticsearch and a message broker (RabbitMQ or similar) at production scale.
Experience with observability, monitoring and incident management.
Strong security fundamentals: access control, networking, secrets.
CI/CD experience, including zero-downtime deploys.
Organised and a clear writer, comfortable working in Jira.
A hands-on mindset: able to go from strategy to implementation.

Additional experience considered a plus
Experience with Ruby on Rails, Sidekiq, Puma and PostGIS, or similar.
Exposure to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001).
Experience with AWS or Google Cloud alongside Azure.
Experience moving a long-running application to containers or Kubernetes.
A travel, mobility or marketplace background with real-time operations.

Benefits

Vibrant and fresh work environment
Flexible work-from-home policy
The tools you need to perform your daily tasks successfully
L&D personal budget
Private Insurance Plan
+4 extra PTO days annually
The unique opportunity to join "the next big thing" at ground level
